texts.en: Our sensors are registering energy emissions indicative of alien activity on [Root.GetName].

texts.zh:
我们似乎遭遇了一种非原生无毛哺乳动物的繁殖地。我们观察到它们在晚间进行高级求偶活动，随后在各种酒精化学物质的作用下，于夜晚的沙滩上亲密地进行对偶结合。

可惜的是，它们意外地发现了我们的舰船，并惊慌失措地搭乘一艘商业舰船逃离了星球，留下了一地的垃圾。我们在其中发现了一本外星旅行指南书——《银河系漫游指南》，描述了许多我们未知的景观与现象。
texts.en:
We seem to have stumbled upon the breeding grounds of a non-native species of hairless mammalians. They could be observed engaging in advanced courtship in the evening followed by intimate pair-bonding on the sandy beaches at night, under the influence of a variety of intoxicating substances.

Regrettably an unintended sighting of our vessel spooked them and they have since vacated the planet in a commercial spacecraft, leaving behind them a trail of litter. Amongst it we have found a copy of the alien travel guide "A Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy," describing many sights and phenomena still unknown to us.

label.zh: 这本指南书将鼓舞我们！
label.en: This guide will serve as an inspiration to our people!

label.zh: 肮脏的外星人！人们必须知道它们是游手好闲并乱丢垃圾的不利因素。
label.en: Filthy aliens! Our people must know what a littering, loitering liability they are.

label.zh: 我们现在最好对此保密……
label.en: We had better put a lid on this discovery for now...

summary.text:
# 外星人活动 / Alien Activity

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：《遥远繁星》Distant Stars（has_distar） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/95_anomaly_categories_distant_stars.txt:1221-1235; events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:2351 (distar.1060)

## 如何开始 How it starts

需要《遥远繁星》。盖亚星球可能生成（3级，权重3，全局一次）。

Requires Distant Stars. Can spawn on Gaia planets (level 3, weight 3, once per game).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

distar.1060“新婚情侣”：一种无毛哺乳类外星人把这里当作蜜月海滩，被我方飞船惊走后留下垃圾和一本外星旅行指南《银河系漫游指南》。所有选项都给予社会学研究；亲外选择鼓舞人民（10年修正），排外选择宣传它们是乱扔垃圾的累赘（10年修正）。

distar.1060 "Honeymooners": hairless mammalian aliens use the planet as a honeymoon beach, flee our ship and leave litter and an alien travel guide, "A Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy". Every option gives society research; xenophiles can make it an inspiration (10-year modifier), xenophobes a warning about littering aliens (10-year modifier).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

单一结果，选项由思潮决定。

Single result; options depend on ethics.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

亲外：鼓舞或保密；排外：宣传或保密；其他：“恶心！”或“很迷人”。

Xenophile: inspire or keep quiet; xenophobe: denounce or keep quiet; others: "Gross!" or "Fascinating".

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对异常与 distar.1060。30天后的通用接触报告 story.5 是共享事件，不属于本故事。

Checked the anomaly and distar.1060. The generic contact report story.5 30 days later is a shared helper, not part of this story.
